decisions.reason: Real vulnerability class (GitSpawn): malicious repos can abuse Git core.fsmonitor to execute arbitrary code when AI coding agents open the project. No user interaction required. Affects Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Goose, Hermes, Qwen Code.

Same GitSpawn story from CyberPress. More detailed: explains core.fsmonitor mechanism, attacker places arbitrary command in .git/config, agent triggers it on project open. Consolidate with gbhackers coverage.
